items.title: Nubank rejects Monzo takeover talk
items.summary: Brazilian digital banking giant Nubank has denied that it is pursuing a $10 billion takeover of Britain's Monzo.
items.why: Official denial of a rumored $10 billion fintech takeover.

items.title: Delay to the November 2026 RTGS standards release
items.summary: Bank of England statement
items.why: Unexpected delay to the implementation timeline of critical RTGS infrastructure standards.

items.title: Federal Reserve Board finalizes changes to enhance the transparency and public accountability of its stress test and reduce volatility in its stress test-related capital requirements
items.summary: Federal Reserve Board finalizes changes to enhance the transparency and public accountability of its stress test and reduce volatility in its stress test-related capital requirements
items.why: Finalized regulatory changes modifying bank stress testing and capital requirement volatility.

items.title: Nubank halts Monzo acquisition talks after shares plunge
items.why: Major acquisition talks reportedly halted following market stock movements.

items.title: Online scams agreement signed between UK and Cambodian governments
items.summary: The UK and Cambodia will work together to tackle networks of illegal scam centres, locations where sophisticated fraud techniques are deployed and scaled to target thousands of victims.
items.why: New international government agreement to target cross-border online scam networks.

items.title: Bitget hit by $387.5 million hack
items.summary: Bitget has halted customer withdrawals after hackers that the crypto exchange suspects are linked to North Korea stole more than $380 million.
items.why: Major crypto exchange hacked for nearly $390 million with withdrawals halted.

items.title: US prosecutors seize Tether-linked payment firm's bank accounts - FT
items.summary: US federal prosecutors have seized bank accounts belonging Capstone, a payments business working on behalf of stablecoin issuer Tether and its sister exchange Bitfinex, according to the Financial Times.
items.why: Federal law enforcement action seizing bank accounts connected to Tether payment processing.

items.title: Revolut gets green light to buy Argentinian bank
items.summary: Revolut has received the regulatory go-ahead to acquire small Argentinian lender Banco Cetelem from BNP Paribas.
items.why: Regulatory approval for Revolut to acquire an Argentinian bank and expand presence.

items.title: Nubank in talks to take over Monzo
items.summary: Brazilian neobank Nubank is reportedly eyeing a takeover of UK digital bank Monzo, in a deal that would value the British challenger at $10 billion.
items.why: Major cross-border fintech M&A talks valuing Monzo at $10 billion.

items.title: Swift provides cross-border gateway to Bizum, PayID and Pix users
items.summary: Swift has launched an initiative to bring the pay-by-alias experience of domestic national payment systems, Bizum, PayID and Pix, to cross-border transactions, enabling consumers to send money internationally using a mobile number or email address, rather than account details.
items.why: Swift launching cross-border pay-by-alias connecting domestic payment networks like Pix and PayID is a major infrastructure expansion.

items.title: FCA secures money back for victims of crypto fraud
items.summary: Victims of a £1.5m crypto investment fraud will recover lost funds after the Financial Conduct Authority obtained confiscation orders against Raymondip Bedi and Patrick Mavanga.
items.why: FCA secures confiscation orders to return funds to fraud victims.

items.title: Valley Bank to buy digital SME banking platform Bluevine
items.summary: Regional lender Valley National Bank has agreed to buy SME digital banking platform Bluevine for around $340 million in cash and stock.
items.why: Major $340 million acquisition of SME banking platform Bluevine by Valley National Bank.

items.title: HSBC prepares for the launch of HK$-backed stablecoin, RedCoin
items.summary: HSBC's forthcoming stablecoin launch in Hong Kong will bear the brand RedCoin.
items.why: Major bank launching a new HKD-backed stablecoin.

items.title: Sibos 2026: 'ISO 20022 is the Sagrada Familia of the financial industry'
items.summary: Representatives from Swift, Standard Chartered Bank, Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Deloitte took to the stage at Sibos 2026 in Miami to discuss the decision to postpone the removal of unstructured addresses, despite the push towards the long-term objectives of ISO 20022.
items.why: Decision to postpone key ISO 20022 transition deadline.

items.title: Visa and Lloyds complete live trials of stablecoin settlement
items.summary: Visa and Lloyds Banking Group have completed a live pilot exploring how stablecoin-based settlement could support faster, more transparent and flexible cross-border transactions.
items.why: Live trial of stablecoin settlement by major financial institutions.

items.title: UK competition watchdog raises concerns over Brink's-NCR Atleos deal
items.summary: The UK's competition watchdog says it will undertake an in-depth investigation into cash management giant Brink's' planned $6.6 billion deal to buy ATM operator NCR Atleos - unless the parties take action to address concerns.
items.why: UK CMA threatens in-depth probe into $6.6B Brink's-NCR Atleos merger.

items.title: Capitolis agrees $200m eSecLending acquisition
items.summary: Capital markets technology provider Capitolis has added securities lending capabilities to its platform through a $200 million all-cash deal to buy eSecLending.
items.why: Significant $200 million acquisition of eSecLending by Capitolis.

items.title: Apple Pay arrives in India
items.summary: Apple Pay is finally launching in India, entering a huge but competitive market via a partnership with Axis Bank.
items.why: Major market entry for Apple Pay into India's competitive payments sector.

items.title: European payments groups join forces to take on US giants
items.summary: Some of Europe's biggest payments groups - Bancomat, Bizum, Wero, Sibs-MB WAY and Vipps MobilePay - have banded together to create a cross-continent network that can take on Visa and Mastercard.
items.why: Major European payment schemes unite to build a cross-border alternative to Visa and Mastercard.

items.title: Stripe to buy embedded finance platform Parafin
items.summary: Stripe has agreed to buy embedded financial products platform Parafin. Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.
items.why: Acquisition of embedded finance platform Parafin by major fintech firm Stripe.

items.title: Fiserv digital platform goes live with FI clients
items.summary: Fiserv, Inc. (NASDAQ: FISV), a leading global provider of payments and financial services technology, today announced that its digital asset platform is live with financial institution clients, marking a significant milestone in the commercialization of stablecoin-enabled banking and payments.
items.why: Fiserv launches digital asset platform live with clients.

items.title: Sardine launches AI research lab
items.summary: Sardine, the leading agentic risk platform for fighting fraud and financial crime, today launched Sardine AI Labs, an applied research group advancing frontier intelligence to fight financial crime.
items.why: Sardine launches new AI research lab for financial crime.

items.title: Bloomberg closes Canoe Intelligence acquisition
items.summary: Bloomberg today announced the completion of its acquisition of Canoe Intelligence (“Canoe”), a leading AI-powered data management and intelligence platform for automating private markets data collection and delivery.
items.why: Bloomberg completes acquisition of Canoe Intelligence.

items.title: BMO joins Project Agorá
items.summary: BMO today announced its participation in Project Agorá, the global public-private collaboration convened by the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) and the Institute of International Finance (IIF) to explore how tokenization and programmability could enhance wholesale cross-border payments.
items.why: BMO joins BIS Project Agora for tokenization.

items.title: New York and Wyoming regulators ink virtual currency MoU
items.summary: The New York State Department of Financial Services (DFS) Acting Superintendent Kaitlin Asrow and the Wyoming Division of Banking Commissioner Jeremiah Bishop today announced a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to facilitate coordinated oversight of entities engaged in virtual currency and digital asset activities in New York and Wyoming.
items.why: New regulatory coordination agreement established between key US state crypto regulators.

items.title: Fed proposes stablecoin rules
items.summary: figure div img src="https://imgproxy.divecdn.com/-DqnjKLPOoTxBe41IMfQlKwOAe4ddPFzjshnZ1A3j-c/g:nowe:28:0/c:2730:1542/rs:fill:1600:900:1/Z3M6Ly9kaXZlc2l0ZS1zdG9yYWdlL2RpdmVpbWFnZS9HZXR0eUltYWdlcy0yMjUwMjQyNTQzLmpwZw==.webp"/ /div /figure p In a statement issued alongside proposed rules, Fed Gov. Michael Barr said stablecoins ldquo;will only be stable if they can be reliably and promptly redeemed at par in a range of conditions. rdquo; /p
items.why: Federal Reserve proposes new regulatory rules governing stablecoins.

items.title: China, US agree to AI dialogue, $42b in tariff cuts during state visit
items.summary: The tariff reductions are set to apply to US exports such as agricultural goods, wood and cosmetics, as well as US imports including small appliances, toys, decorations.
items.why: Major US-China policy agreement involving $42 billion in tariff cuts and structured AI dialogue.

items.title: November rate rise less likely with inflation data lower than expected
items.summary: The odds of the Reserve Bank lifting interest rates in November have fallen sharply after the latest consumer price index (CPI) came in lower than expected. News figures from the ABS show show headline inflation jumped to 4 per cent in the year to August.
items.why: Surprising CPI data significantly alters expectations for upcoming RBA monetary policy decisions.

items.title: Fed finalizes stress-test changes
items.summary: figure div img src="https://imgproxy.divecdn.com/_PqJfVWcT6jlTfelmc_ci_7nu32HDq6Z3iEs6uHF70I/g:ce/rs:fill:1600:900:1/Z3M6Ly9kaXZlc2l0ZS1zdG9yYWdlL2RpdmVpbWFnZS9HZXR0eUltYWdlcy0yMjY3NDQxMzQ2LmpwZw==.webp"/ /div /figure p The central bank issued updates meant to make test scenarios more transparent and reduce year-to-year volatility banks see in their capital requirements. /p
items.why: Federal Reserve finalizes regulatory changes to bank stress-testing framework.

items.title: RBA relaxed about housing downturn, deeply worried by AI and bonds
items.summary: Despite Australia's rapid housing downturn, which threatens to be the worst in decades, the Reserve Bank believes the main threats to the nation's financial stability come from overseas.
items.why: RBA reveals surprising financial stability assessment, prioritizing AI and bond risks over severe housing downturn.

items.title: Fed watchdog finds mismanagement, not criminality, in $2.5B renovation
items.summary: figure div img src="https://imgproxy.divecdn.com/IyLvEyg_KWQkDgLwQcJZ2sCN8leqr9CJkeGNHhspC6c/g:ce/rs:fill:1600:900:1/Z3M6Ly9kaXZlc2l0ZS1zdG9yYWdlL2RpdmVpbWFnZS9HZXR0eUltYWdlcy0yMjM1NzY2NzI2LmpwZw==.webp"/ /div /figure p The Federal Reserve Board should establish a guaranteed maximum price for its renovation project, which is now several years in, the Office of the Inspector General said. /p
items.why: Fed watchdog finds mismanagement in $2.5B renovation.

items.title: 'We've heard the feedback': TasWater rethinks big sewerage bill increases
items.summary: Tasmanian businesses and sport clubs had said they were hit hard by the changes to sewerage prices, with one business stating their bill had risen from $630 to $3,800 a month.
items.why: Utility policy reversal rethinking massive price increases following commercial feedback.
